summary: Reproduced the DeepSeek-V4 model hook rejecting the raw NEXTN alias before speculative decoding canonicalizes it to EAGLE. The narrow fix accepts NEXTN wherever the hook accepts EAGLE, including the same top-k=1 constraint. A regression verifies that the reported NEXTN configuration passes the model hook and is subsequently canonicalized to EAGLE; boundary cases retain EAGLE and DSPARK support and reject invalid NEXTN top-k and NGRAM.

tests.what_was_measured: Before the fix, directly exercised the checked-out DeepSeek-V4 hook: NEXTN/topk=1 raised the reported unsupported-algorithm assertion, EAGLE/topk=1 and DSPARK passed, and EAGLE/topk=2 raised the top-k assertion. The script intentionally caught and printed each outcome; raw output is reports/j-c432ba6121ae/raw/reproduction-before.txt.
Failing-before regression: the unmodified hook rejected NEXTN before alias canonicalization. Raw output is reports/j-c432ba6121ae/raw/regression-before.txt.

Passing-after regression and independent boundaries: 4 tests passed with 2 subtests, covering NEXTN-to-EAGLE canonicalization, NEXTN top-k rejection, existing EAGLE/DSPARK acceptance, and NGRAM rejection. Raw output is reports/j-c432ba6121ae/raw/regression-final.txt.

Broader server-argument suite: 224 passed and 2 unrelated context-parallel tests failed because this ROCm environment intentionally rejects prefill CP on HIP before those tests' expected validation. Raw output is reports/j-c432ba6121ae/raw/server-args-suite.txt.
No whitespace errors in the proposed patch.

gpu_execution_evidence: No GPU kernels were executed because the defect occurs in deterministic server-argument hook ordering before model loading. Hardware inventory confirmed one assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, recorded in reports/j-c432ba6121ae/raw/environment.txt; it cannot reproduce the reported 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell TP=2 deployment.
remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash weights were not available, so a full server/model load was not run.
The reported two-GPU sm_120 TP=2 environment was unavailable; only one gfx950 GPU was assigned.
The tiny Llama serving fixture was not used because it cannot qualify DeepseekV4ForCausalLM model-specific hook behavior.
The broader server-argument suite has two pre-existing environment-specific failures in context-parallel tests on HIP; all 224 other tests passed.
No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
